filter/case_predicate::bigquery:
SELECT
  orders.region AS `orders___region`,
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `orders___rev`
FROM orders AS orders
GROUP BY
  orders.region
HAVING
  CASE WHEN SUM(orders.amount) >= 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1
